title: Benchmark runs
description: The Helium commits CI benchmarked, by branch: whether each is running or complete, and for the running one its progress, speed against main and an estimate of the remaining time (bench_runs, bench_targets, helium_runs; branches and pull requests from GitHub).

list.name: commits
list.label: Commits
list.description: Hidden: every benchmarked commit with its pull request, for the GitHub lookup.
list.query:
WITH att AS (
  -- CI attempts. A host runs one job at a time, so a RUNNING attempt is live
  -- only while no later attempt started on its host or for its commit (a killed
  -- job leaves its row RUNNING, and a recreated runner container gets a new host)
  SELECT r.*, r.status = 'RUNNING' AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM bench_runs o
           WHERE (o.host IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.host OR o.helium_commit = r.helium_commit) AND o.started_at > r.started_at) AS live
  FROM bench_runs r
),
tg AS (
  -- CI target of a commit (main wins over a PR)
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (helium_commit) helium_commit, pr_number
  FROM bench_targets
  ORDER BY helium_commit, pr_number NULLS FIRST
),
c AS (
  -- one row per benchmarked commit, over all its attempts
  SELECT a.helium_commit, tg.pr_number,
         bool_or(a.live) AS live, bool_or(a.status = 'COMPLETE') AS complete,
         (array_agg(a.status::text ORDER BY a.started_at DESC))[1] AS last_status,
         count(*) AS attempts, min(a.started_at) AS first_started, max(a.started_at) AS last_started,
         max(a.started_at) FILTER (WHERE a.live) AS live_started,
         max(a.finished_at) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'COMPLETE') AS completed_at,
         (array_agg(a.run_id ORDER BY a.started_at DESC))[1] AS run_id,
         (array_agg(a.github_run_url ORDER BY a.started_at DESC))[1] AS run_url
  FROM att a LEFT JOIN tg USING (helium_commit)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
cr AS (
  -- reference: the newest other main commit with a complete run
  SELECT c.*, (SELECT m.helium_commit FROM c m
               WHERE m.pr_number IS NULL AND m.complete AND m.helium_commit <> c.helium_commit
               ORDER BY m.completed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS ref
  FROM c
),
f AS (
  -- Helium time per commit and file (CI-owned runs; the runner skips files by
  -- content hash): timed runs plus the untimed warm-ups, taken as long as the average timed run
  SELECT h.backend_version AS helium_commit, h.vpr_sha256,
         coalesce(sum(h.wall_s), 0) + coalesce(max((h.meta->>'warmup')::int), 0) * coalesce(avg(h.wall_s), 0) AS cost
  FROM helium_runs h JOIN bench_runs b ON b.run_id = h.run_id AND b.helium_commit = h.backend_version
  WHERE NOT coalesce(h.dirty, false)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
e AS (
  SELECT cr.*,
         count(j.cv) AS done, count(j.rv) AS ref_files,
         coalesce(sum(j.cc), 0) AS spent,
         sum(j.cc) FILTER (WHERE j.rv IS NOT NULL) AS c_common,
         sum(j.rc) FILTER (WHERE j.cv IS NOT NULL) AS r_common,
         coalesce(sum(j.rc) FILTER (WHERE j.cv IS NULL), 0) AS r_left
  FROM cr LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT fc.vpr_sha256 AS cv, fc.cost AS cc, fr.vpr_sha256 AS rv, fr.cost AS rc
    FROM (SELECT vpr_sha256, cost FROM f WHERE f.helium_commit = cr.helium_commit) fc
    FULL JOIN (SELECT vpr_sha256, cost FROM f WHERE f.helium_commit = cr.ref) fr ON fr.vpr_sha256 = fc.vpr_sha256
  ) j ON true
  GROUP BY cr.helium_commit, cr.pr_number, cr.live, cr.complete, cr.last_status, cr.attempts, cr.first_started,
           cr.last_started, cr.live_started, cr.completed_at, cr.run_id, cr.run_url, cr.ref
),
x AS (
  SELECT e.*,
         CASE WHEN live THEN 'running' WHEN complete THEN 'complete'
              WHEN last_status = 'RUNNING' THEN 'interrupted' ELSE lower(last_status) END AS state,
         r_common / nullif(c_common, 0) AS speedup,
         CASE WHEN live THEN r_left * c_common / nullif(r_common, 0) END AS remaining
  FROM e
)
SELECT helium_commit || ':' || coalesce(pr_number::text, 'main') FROM x

panels.title: Running now
panels.description: The CI job measuring right now. Only Helium is timed: Silicon and rustc results are reused across commits, so only the very first run measured them. Commit and CI target (main or pull request) of the job.

FROM x WHERE state = 'running'
ORDER BY live_started DESC

panels.title: Progress
panels.description: Files measured, against the files of the newest complete main commit.

panels.title: Speedup vs main
panels.description: Helium time of the newest complete main commit over this commit's, on the files both have measured. Above 1: faster.

panels.title: Elapsed
panels.description: Wall-clock time since this CI attempt started.

panels.title: Remaining
panels.description: The main commit's Helium time on the files still to go, scaled by the speedup so far. Leaves out the file being measured and the time between files.

panels.title: Commits by branch
panels.description: Every Helium commit CI benchmarked, grouped by branch: main first, then the pull requests, newest activity first. A commit's files are spread over all its CI attempts (a re-run skips the files already measured), so Progress and the times add up every attempt. Status: running (the job measuring now), complete (an attempt went through every file), interrupted (the job was killed, its row stayed RUNNING), failed, cancelled. A RUNNING attempt counts as running only while no later attempt started on its host or for its commit. Speedup vs main compares Helium time with the newest other complete main commit on the files both have measured (above 1: faster). For the running commit, Remaining is that main commit's time on the files still to go, scaled by the ratio; Estimated total adds the time spent so far. Helium time is the time spent in Helium: the timed iterations plus the untimed warm-ups, taken as long as the average timed iteration; only Helium is timed, as Silicon and rustc results are reused across commits. Branch, pull request and PR state come live from GitHub (one request per refresh; GitHub allows 60 unauthenticated requests per hour, see grafana/provisioning/datasources/github.yaml for a token). Click a commit to open it, the CI run to open its GitHub Actions run.

  -- CI target of a commit (main wins over a PR)
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (helium_commit) helium_commit, pr_number
  FROM bench_targets

c AS (
  -- one row per benchmarked commit, over all its attempts
  SELECT a.helium_commit, tg.pr_number,
         bool_or(a.live) AS live, bool_or(a.status = 'COMPLETE') AS complete,
         (array_agg(a.status::text ORDER BY a.started_at DESC))[1] AS last_status,
         count(*) AS attempts, min(a.started_at) AS first_started, max(a.started_at) AS last_started,

         (array_agg(a.run_id ORDER BY a.started_at DESC))[1] AS run_id,

  GROUP BY 1, 2

cr AS (
  -- reference: the newest other main commit with a complete run
  SELECT c.*, (SELECT m.helium_commit FROM c m
               WHERE m.pr_number IS NULL AND m.complete AND m.helium_commit <> c.helium_commit
               ORDER BY m.completed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS ref
  FROM c

  -- Helium time per commit and file (CI-owned runs; the runner skips files by
  -- content hash): timed runs plus the untimed warm-ups, taken as long as the average timed run

         coalesce(sum(j.cc), 0) AS spent,
         sum(j.cc) FILTER (WHERE j.rv IS NOT NULL) AS c_common,
         sum(j.rc) FILTER (WHERE j.cv IS NOT NULL) AS r_common,
         coalesce(sum(j.rc) FILTER (WHERE j.cv IS NULL), 0) AS r_left

    SELECT fc.vpr_sha256 AS cv, fc.cost AS cc, fr.vpr_sha256 AS rv, fr.cost AS rc
    FROM (SELECT vpr_sha256, cost FROM f WHERE f.helium_commit = cr.helium_commit) fc

SELECT coalesce('PR #' || pr_number, 'main') AS "CI target", helium_commit AS "Commit", state AS "Status",
       CASE WHEN complete AND NOT live THEN 1 ELSE done::float / nullif(coalesce(nullif(ref_files, 0), done), 0) END AS "Progress",
       done || CASE WHEN ref_files > 0 THEN ' / ' || ref_files ELSE '' END AS "Files",
       speedup AS "Speedup vs main", left(ref, 8) AS "Main commit",
       CASE WHEN round(spent)::bigint >= 86400 THEN round(spent)::bigint / 86400 || 'd ' || round(spent)::bigint % 86400 / 3600 || 'h ' || round(spent)::bigint % 3600 / 60 || 'm' WHEN round(spent)::bigint >= 3600 THEN round(spent)::bigint / 3600 || 'h ' || round(spent)::bigint % 3600 / 60 || 'm ' || round(spent)::bigint % 60 || 's' WHEN round(spent)::bigint >= 60 THEN round(spent)::bigint / 60 || 'm ' || round(spent)::bigint % 60 || 's' ELSE round(spent)::bigint || 's' END AS "Helium time", CASE WHEN round(spent + remaining)::bigint >= 86400 THEN round(spent + remaining)::bigint / 86400 || 'd ' || round(spent + remaining)::bigint % 86400 / 3600 || 'h ' || round(spent + remaining)::bigint % 3600 / 60 || 'm' WHEN round(spent + remaining)::bigint >= 3600 THEN round(spent + remaining)::bigint / 3600 || 'h ' || round(spent + remaining)::bigint % 3600 / 60 || 'm ' || round(spent + remaining)::bigint % 60 || 's' WHEN round(spent + remaining)::bigint >= 60 THEN round(spent + remaining)::bigint / 60 || 'm ' || round(spent + remaining)::bigint % 60 || 's' ELSE round(spent + remaining)::bigint || 's' END AS "Estimated total",
       CASE WHEN round(remaining)::bigint >= 86400 THEN round(remaining)::bigint / 86400 || 'd ' || round(remaining)::bigint % 86400 / 3600 || 'h ' || round(remaining)::bigint % 3600 / 60 || 'm' WHEN round(remaining)::bigint >= 3600 THEN round(remaining)::bigint / 3600 || 'h ' || round(remaining)::bigint % 3600 / 60 || 'm ' || round(remaining)::bigint % 60 || 's' WHEN round(remaining)::bigint >= 60 THEN round(remaining)::bigint / 60 || 'm ' || round(remaining)::bigint % 60 || 's' ELSE round(remaining)::bigint || 's' END AS "Remaining",
       now() + remaining * interval '1 second' AS "ETA",
       CASE WHEN round(extract(epoch FROM now() - live_started))::bigint >= 86400 THEN round(extract(epoch FROM now() - live_started))::bigint / 86400 || 'd ' || round(extract(epoch FROM now() - live_started))::bigint % 86400 / 3600 || 'h ' || round(extract(epoch FROM now() - live_started))::bigint % 3600 / 60 || 'm' WHEN round(extract(epoch FROM now() - live_started))::bigint >= 3600 THEN round(extract(epoch FROM now() - live_started))::bigint / 3600 || 'h ' || round(extract(epoch FROM now() - live_started))::bigint % 3600 / 60 || 'm ' || round(extract(epoch FROM now() - live_started))::bigint % 60 || 's' WHEN round(extract(epoch FROM now() - live_started))::bigint >= 60 THEN round(extract(epoch FROM now() - live_started))::bigint / 60 || 'm ' || round(extract(epoch FROM now() - live_started))::bigint % 60 || 's' ELSE round(extract(epoch FROM now() - live_started))::bigint || 's' END AS "Elapsed", attempts AS "Attempts",
       first_started AS "First started", completed_at AS "Completed",
       run_id AS "Latest CI run", run_url
FROM x
-- main first, then the pull requests by their newest attempt; newest commits first
ORDER BY pr_number IS NOT NULL, max(last_started) OVER (PARTITION BY pr_number) DESC, last_started DESC

targets.root_selector: . as $p | [${commits:doublequote}] | map(split(":") as [$v, $t] | (first($p[] | select((.number | tostring) == $t)) // {}) as $pr | {commit: $v, branch: (if $t == "main" then "main" else $pr.head.ref end), pr: $pr.title, state: (if $pr.merged_at then "merged" else $pr.state end)})

panels.title: CI attempts
panels.description: Every CI attempt (bench_runs), newest first. Files measured: the files this attempt added; a re-run skips the files its commit already has. Duration: finished minus started (running: so far); an interrupted attempt has no end. Click a CI run to open it on GitHub.

targets.rawSql:
WITH att AS (
  -- see the Commits panel: a RUNNING attempt is live only while no later attempt
  -- started on its host or for its commit
  SELECT r.*, r.status = 'RUNNING' AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM bench_runs o
           WHERE (o.host IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.host OR o.helium_commit = r.helium_commit) AND o.started_at > r.started_at) AS live
  FROM bench_runs r
),
n AS (
  SELECT run_id, count(DISTINCT vpr_sha256) AS files, sum(wall_s) AS timed_s FROM helium_runs GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT a.run_id AS "CI run", a.helium_commit AS "Commit",
       CASE WHEN a.live THEN 'running' WHEN a.status = 'RUNNING' THEN 'interrupted' ELSE lower(a.status::text) END AS "Status",
       a.started_at AS "Started", a.finished_at AS "Finished",
       CASE WHEN round(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(a.finished_at, CASE WHEN a.live THEN now() END) - a.started_at))::bigint >= 86400 THEN round(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(a.finished_at, CASE WHEN a.live THEN now() END) - a.started_at))::bigint / 86400 || 'd ' || round(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(a.finished_at, CASE WHEN a.live THEN now() END) - a.started_at))::bigint % 86400 / 3600 || 'h ' || round(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(a.finished_at, CASE WHEN a.live THEN now() END) - a.started_at))::bigint % 3600 / 60 || 'm' WHEN round(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(a.finished_at, CASE WHEN a.live THEN now() END) - a.started_at))::bigint >= 3600 THEN round(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(a.finished_at, CASE WHEN a.live THEN now() END) - a.started_at))::bigint / 3600 || 'h ' || round(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(a.finished_at, CASE WHEN a.live THEN now() END) - a.started_at))::bigint % 3600 / 60 || 'm ' || round(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(a.finished_at, CASE WHEN a.live THEN now() END) - a.started_at))::bigint % 60 || 's' WHEN round(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(a.finished_at, CASE WHEN a.live THEN now() END) - a.started_at))::bigint >= 60 THEN round(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(a.finished_at, CASE WHEN a.live THEN now() END) - a.started_at))::bigint / 60 || 'm ' || round(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(a.finished_at, CASE WHEN a.live THEN now() END) - a.started_at))::bigint % 60 || 's' ELSE round(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(a.finished_at, CASE WHEN a.live THEN now() END) - a.started_at))::bigint || 's' END AS "Duration",
       n.files AS "Files measured", a.host AS "Host", a.github_run_url
FROM att a LEFT JOIN n USING (run_id)
ORDER BY a.started_at DESC
